title: Test suite full run crashes — resource exhaustion, not a bug
content: Running ALL 1452 tests at once causes segfault (exit code -1073741819). Individual suites all pass. This is resource exhaustion from concurrent compilation of 200+ suites, not a logic bug. The LLVM global state accumulation from compiling many suites in one process eventually corrupts memory. Mitigations in place: ThreadBudget limits concurrency, forced subprocess LLD, SEH wrapping. Full suite run should use sharding or sequential suite-by-suite execution.
